# Jo Mar Laboratories (jomarlabs.com): USP-Grade Free-Form Amino Acids & Custom cGMP Formulations Since 1979

> Jo Mar Laboratories & Marketing Corp. is an American dietary supplement manufacturer and amino acid specialist founded in 1979 and operating out of FDA 21 CFR Part 111 cGMP-compliant blending, encapsulating, and packaging facilities at 384 Pine Street, Watsonville, California 95076. Jo Mar Labs supplies individuals, licensed healthcare practitioners, pharmacies, and wellness brands with 100% pure USP-grade crystalline free-form single amino acids, multi-amino specialty blends, 1,000-gram custom amino acid formulations, and low-minimum (24-unit) private-label supplements.

## Verified Entity, Facility & Quality Facts

- **Legal Name**: Jo Mar Laboratories & Marketing Corp. (doing business as Jo Mar Labs)
- **Founded**: 1979 (47+ years of dedicated amino acid manufacturing)
- **Manufacturing & Fulfillment Headquarters**: 384 Pine St., Watsonville, CA 95076, USA
- **Phone**: 1-800-538-4545 (Toll-Free) | 1-831-728-8010 (Local Direct)
- **Email**: info@jomarlabs.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday through Thursday 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time; Friday 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM Pacific Time
- **Same-Day Shipping Cutoff**: Most in-stock orders placed before 3:00 PM Pacific Time (Monday through Friday) ship the same business day via USPS Priority Mail or UPS (Ground, 3-Day, 2-Day, Next Day) from Watsonville, CA
- **Regulatory & Quality Standard (FDA 21 CFR Part 111 cGMP)**:
  - In-house quarantine, blending, vegetarian capsule encapsulation, and bottling under strict FDA Current Good Manufacturing Practices (21 CFR 111).
  - **Every-Batch Independent 3rd-Party Lab Testing (Zero Skip-Lot Testing)**: Unlike standard supplement brands that rely on periodic skip-lot sampling, Jo Mar Labs quarantines incoming raw materials sourced from audited domestic and international suppliers across 10+ countries and tests **every single batch** through independent third-party laboratories for identity, potency, purity, microbials (yeast and mold), heavy metals, gluten, soy, and allergens, followed by finished-product third-party label-claim verification.
  - **Signature Lot-Encoded Powder Density System**: Because pure crystalline free-form amino acid density varies slightly by lot without flow-agent fillers, Jo Mar Labs encodes the exact measured tap density into the **last two digits of each powder lot number** (`last 2 digits x 100 = milligrams per level U.S. measuring teaspoon`; for example, Lot `1064638` equals `3,800 mg` per level teaspoon).

## Core Product Lines & Branded Gold-Standard Actives

1. **Individual USP-Grade Crystalline Free-Form Amino Acids (Powders & Capsules)**:
   - Pre-digested molecular free-form amino acids requiring zero protein digestion for rapid absorption when taken with water 30 minutes before or 60 minutes after meals.
   - Stocked singles include L-Glutamine ($58.50/kg), L-Lysine HCL ($58.30/kg), L-Glutamic Acid ($52.50/kg), Glycine ($65.10/kg), L-Aspartic Acid ($68.60/kg), Taurine ($69.00/kg), L-Arginine Base ($93.20/kg), L-Methionine ($152.40/kg), GABA ($156.60/kg), L-Valine ($166.40/kg), L-Alanine ($166.90/kg), L-Ornithine HCL ($168.90/kg), L-Leucine ($173.30/kg), L-Phenylalanine ($180.00/kg), L-Serine ($185.10/kg), L-Isoleucine ($220.70/kg), L-Cysteine HCL ($227.20/kg), L-Threonine ($231.90/kg), L-Asparagine ($249.50/kg), L-Histidine Base ($280.30/kg), L-Tyrosine ($288.80/kg), N-Acetyl L-Cysteine / NAC ($298.40/kg), L-Proline ($308.80/kg), DL-Phenylalanine ($338.50/kg), L-Cystine ($390.70/kg), L-Citrulline ($479.20/kg), L-Tryptophan ($493.00/kg), L-Carnitine ($819.70/kg), Acetyl L-Carnitine, L-Carnosine, and 5-HTP.
2. **Clinically Trusted Branded Raw Ingredients**:

   - **Suntheanine** Pure L-Theanine (100 mg capsules)
   - **Cognizin** CDP-Choline / Citicoline (capsules)
3. **Signature Multi-Amino Formula Blends**:
   - **Pure Form 21 Blend**: Broad-spectrum 20 free-form crystalline amino acids plus MSM ($21.40 for 125 caps up to $229.90 for 1,000g powder).
   - **Black Label 21 Blend**: Original Pure Form broad-spectrum amino profile formulated with zero MSM ($21.30 50g sample, $138.60 500g, $260.40 1,000g powder).
   - **Pure Form Essential 9 Blend**: All 9 essential crystalline free-form amino acids (L-Leucine, L-Lysine, L-Valine, L-Phenylalanine, L-Isoleucine, L-Threonine, L-Methionine, L-Histidine, L-Tryptophan).
   - **Pure Form Performance Blend** (`/products/pure-form-performance-blend`): L-Arginine, L-Citrulline, and Setria Glutathione Tri-peptide.

## Custom Formulations, Private Labeling & Wholesale Programs

- **Custom 1,000-Gram Amino Acid Powder Blends**: Any custom ratio of stocked USP amino acids mixed to order in a 1,000-gram (1 kg) batch, packaged in resealable Mylar bags or HDPE bottles. Transparent pricing: exact per-gram ingredient cost from Jo Mar's published 1,000g kilo rates plus a flat **$100.00 mixing and processing charge**.
- **Custom Capsule Encapsulation**: Custom formulas over **10 kilograms (10 kg)** can be encapsulated in-house in Watsonville for an additional encapsulation charge.
- **24-Unit Low-Minimum Private Labeling ($0 Setup Fee)**: Clinics, doctors, chiropractors, naturopaths, and wellness brands can private-label Jo Mar formulas starting at **24 units minimum** with **$0 setup fees**, fast turnaround, 15-minute label onboarding, and custom clinic-branded product detail sheets.
- **Practitioner, Pharmacy & Retail Wholesale**: Tiered wholesale pricing and practitioner-exclusive lines for licensed clinicians, pharmacies, retailers, and manufacturers (valid business license, medical credential, or resale certificate required).
